name: SiliconFlow Free STT
description: Public SiliconFlow preset for the free speech-to-text (ASR) model XingChenAGI/XingChenGSR-V1.0 via the audio-transcriptions API. Add your own API key after import.

connectors.name: SiliconFlow XingChen GSR v1（免费语音识别）
connectors.description: SiliconFlow 免费语音转文本（ASR）模型，走 /v1/audio/transcriptions 接口：multipart 上传音频文件（file 字段）并携带 model 参数，响应返回 { "text": "..." }。默认模型 XingChenAGI/XingChenGSR-V1.0 为官方免费档位，适合本地视频/字幕转录场景。
